TOP: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chained to root, exploited
Cisco Secure Email Gateway zero-day, CVSS 9.8
Claude Code Desktop 'SneakPeek' zero-click credential theft

P.h: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day chained to root, under active attack
P.p: Ivanti warned of a new authentication bypass in its Connect Secure VPN that is low complexity and lets attackers run arbitrary commands. Volexity has seen a threat actor chain it with two other flaws to get root on vulnerable devices.
P.s: Same week: Google warned China-linked actors may mass-exploit a BeyondTrust Remote Support bug used in August (apply BT26-05), and Meta is notifying 1,500 people after a GitHub repo breach.

items.h: Cisco Secure Email Gateway zero-day exploited, CVSS 9.8
items.d: CVE-2026-76519 is being used by unknown attackers to get root. Drupal also patched critical Field UI RCE path CVE-2026-108097 via contributed modules.
Names, addresses, SSNs and driver's license numbers exposed. A hacker claims 7.5M records and posted a 2.5 GB archive.
Malicious HTML in a public repo ran in the preview pane and stole AWS, GitHub, SSH and OAuth credentials. Patched after a bypass of the first fix. Update and drop long-lived creds.

items.h: curl HTTP/2 use-after-free can give RCE
items.d: CVE-2026-92392 fixed in curl 8.23.0. A malicious server could overwrite a freed handle and a function pointer. Found by Anthropic's OSS Scanner.

P.h: Anthropic outgrew git and built its own version control
P.p: With AI-generated code merging 30,000 changes a day, Anthropic built Scion and migrated its monorepo off git in five months. It assumes clients are always online, with a central server, server-side commits and sparse checkouts.
P.s: Result: 200x lower CPU and memory than the old git mirroring setup, and CI checkouts dropped from minutes to seconds.

tiles.d: New Forward action runs custom code on web traffic. DLP can now check if a detected credential is still active.
Paid Workspace, US-English first. No feature-specific admin control.
Lower memory use, steadier Bluetooth and sign-in, fewer restarts.
Central policy management and a self-hostable admin console, starting in four European countries.

P.h: Spacelift routes Cursor agent changes through the same OPA policies
P.p: Agent-driven infrastructure changes now flow through Spacelift using a registered Cursor Origin app with a signing key, so existing OPA policies and approvals still apply. A cited report says 76% would apply AI-generated Terraform with little review.
P.s: Related: Pulumi ESC can now mint short-lived OIDC tokens for any service, and a clean container scan still does not prove an image is trustworthy.

tiles.t: Pulumi ESC issues OIDC tokens for any service
tiles.d: fn::open::oidc mints tokens that expire within an hour. No static API keys for Anthropic, JFrog, Cloudsmith and more.
Nx Console-style malware needs no CVE to slip past a scan.
SQL to filter and redact logs before export, all plans.
Empty results traced to a Postgres-era assumption. Fixed by caching a canonical format.
